description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse the messy WeChat chat log in case_files/raw_chats/case_wechat_export_20240615.txt, filtering out irrelevant chatter and extracting all case elements scattered across multiple conversation turns. (2) Read assets/complaint-template.md and references/legal-complaint-guide.md to understand the required structure. (3) Since the plaintiff is a legal entity (法人), use the company format for the plaintiff section: 名称、住所地、法定代表人姓名及职务、联系方式 — NOT the natural person format. (4) Draft claims using Chinese numeral ordering (一、二、三...) with correct amounts: 货损252,000元, 违约金2,136元, LPR interest from 2024年1月5日, and the mandatory final clause '判令本案诉讼费用由被告承担'. (5) Write a clear facts-and-reasons section covering the contract formation, delivery delay (8 days), cargo damage (1200 chips, 单价210元), rejected compensation attempts, and lawyer letters. (6) Produce the evidence table in the exact pipe-delimited format from the template (序号|证据名称|证据来源|页数|证明目的) with at least 5 rows covering: 货运合同, 签收单, 鉴定报告, 律师函+回执, 内部损失核算表, 银行转账凭证. (7) Close with '此致 深圳市南山区人民法院' (derived from contract clause: 货物交付地管辖), and use the legal entity closing format: company name as 具状人, 法定代表人陈建国 signature notation, and 公章 notation. Save as complaint_draft.md.
